releases.name: v1.0.0 — TaiyiForge First Stable Release / 首个正式版
releases.body:
## v1.0.0 — First Stable Release / 首个正式版

**609 files · +28,679 / -987 lines | 151 test files · 1,170 tests · 0 failures**

### 🏗️ Engine Core / 引擎核心

| EN | ZH |
|----|-----|
| **`/taiyi:plan` Auto-Plan Pipeline** — Input README/PRD/PDF/URL, engine decomposes into independent changes. Auto mode generates full-stack scaffolding. | **`/taiyi:plan` 自动规划流水线** — 输入需求文档，自动拆解模块。Auto 模式一键生成全栈骨架。 |
| **Code Generation Engine** — Template-driven code gen with wiring auto-detection for FastAPI routers, middleware, strategies, adapters, tests. | **代码生成引擎** — 模板驱动，自动检测布线，生成 FastAPI 全栈代码。 |
| **Wiring Detector + Generator** — Auto router registration and middleware ordering. | **布线检测器 + 生成器** — 自动路由注册、中间件排序。 |
| **Architecture Templates (20+)** — Layered, microservices, event-driven, CQRS, hexagonal. | **架构模板 (20+)** — 分层、微服务、事件驱动、CQRS、六边形。 |
| **Plan Audit** — Auto quality review of TASK.md before execution. | **计划审计** — 执行前自动审查 TASK.md 质量。 |
| **Wave Allocator** — Parallel execution planning for multi-change workflows. | **Wave 分配器** — 多 change 并行执行规划。 |
| **Profile System** — 8 profiles (full/api/ui/lite/spike/micro/nano/audit). | **Profile 系统** — 8 种 profile。 |
| **Human Gate Config** — Per-phase fine-grained auto-approval. | **人类门控配置** — 按阶段精细控制审批。 |

### 🧪 Examples / 示例 (8 suites)

| Example | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `translation-assistant/` | LLM translation API: 6 strategies, FastAPI + SSE, Docker/nginx (`agent/` + `llm/` variants). 83 pytest tests. |
| `todo-fullstack/` | Fullstack Todo app: Express + vanilla JS + E2E. 10 tests. |
| `browser-e2e-smoke/` | Playwright browser E2E smoke framework. |
| `verification-suite/` | L0–L4 verification: 151 files, 1,170+ tests in one command. |
| `v28-all-slashes-demo/` | All 28 canonical slash commands with real engine output. |
| `full-flow-demo/` | 9-phase workflow E2E: all 11 artifacts generated. |

### 🧩 Tests / 测试

- **151 test files · 1,170 tests · 0 failures**
- 70 CLI subcommand smoke tests
- 29 Agent role protocol coverage
- 83 Python pytest tests
- Post-install smoke (4-platform skill verification)
- Playwright browser E2E

### ⚙️ CI/CD

- Release Workflow — Auto npm publish + git tag
- Translation Assistant CI — Backend pytest + frontend lint

### 📊 Stats / 统计数据

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| Files changed | 609 |
| Lines added | 28,679 |
| New source files (src/) | 13 |
| New example projects | 6 |
| Tests passing | 1,170 |
| Python tests | 83 |
| CLI smoke commands | 70 |
| Profiles tested | 8 |

# v1.0.0-rc.1 — First 1.x Release Candidate / 首个 1.x 候选版本

## What's New / 新功能
- **`/taiyi:plan`**: Auto project planning + CLI Plan quality audit summary / 自动项目规划 + CLI Plan 质量审查摘要
- **Wave Allocator**: Dynamic Wave allocation via topological sort / 拓扑排序动态 Wave 分配
- **Python Scanner**: Auto-wiring detection for Python modules / Python 模块自动接线检测
- **Full-stack Examples**: translation-assistant + todo-fullstack delivery / 全栈示例交付
- **Docker**: Containerization + Compose + CI/CD pipeline / 容器化 + Compose + CI/CD
- **Playbook**: 6 new development scenarios / 6 个新开发场景
- **README**: Deep optimization for open source clarity / 深度优化面向开源

## Notes / 备注
This is a pre-release candidate. See CHANGELOG.md for full details. / 这是预发布候选版，详见 CHANGELOG.md。

releases.body:
# v0.41.0 — 6 New Scenarios + Cleanup / 6 个新场景 + 清理

## ✨ New Features / 新功能
- **Scenario expansion**: 6 new development scenarios added to playbook system / 新增 6 个开发场景到 playbook 系统
  - `refactor` (lite) — Code refactoring without behavior change / 代码重构，不改行为
  - `hotfix` (nano) — Emergency hotfix / 紧急热修复
  - `prototype` (spike) — Rapid prototype/exploration / 快速原型/探索
  - `config` (micro) — Config-only changes, no code / 只改配置不改代码
  - `docs` (nano) — Docs-only changes, no code / 只改文档不改代码
  - `dep-upgrade` (micro) — Dependency upgrades only / 只升级依赖不改业务

## 🧹 Cleanup / 清理
- Cleaned up stale/unreferenced docs and files / 清理过期/未引用文档和文件
